source_groups: G288 terminal package mismatch despite official card
boundary: APK candidate package identity at freeze time; source/local receipts only
version_architecture: AOSP16 R4 / OH7 ARM64 Bionic package portfolio
problem: G288 froze com.zhiliaoapp.musically.go although earlier G287 official Lite bytes had observed com.tiktok.lite.go; the subsequent hyphen URL also delivered com.tiktok.lite.go, causing one avoidable target-identity terminal path before G290 separate intake.
baseline: G288 frozen expected package mismatch led to terminal failure after 48,413,684-byte GET (4.734 s). G288 root terminal at 11:48:31Z; G290 separate raw root at 11:53:20Z, 289 s elapsed. The GET bytes were later useful for G290, so this is iteration cost, not wasted transfer. G279 separately showed cheap preflight can stop before a write gate; it is context, not the selected mechanism.
hypothesis: A pre-freeze crosscheck between intended package and independently observed same-product Manifest/registry package will flag an unresolved conflict before one-shot dispatch while allowing matching controls.

options.name: freeze from official card/version alone
options.risk: card may not declare Android package; repeat G288 target mismatch

options.name: crosscheck package provenance before freeze
options.risk: same-product variants may legitimately use different packages; conflict must hold rather than auto-relabel
options.benefit: makes ambiguity explicit before GET and prepares separate-package route

selected_one_improvement: Pre-freeze package-identity conflict gate: compare exact intended Android package to prior independent Manifest or registered package linked to the same product/channel; a conflict requires distinct-package review before releasing a one-shot expected-package task. Never silently substitute identity.
cost_cap: one local read-only replay, no network GET, chmod, stage, graph, device, container or count edit
acceptance: G288 conflict flagged and G284 registry/runner match permitted in a local pilot under 1 second; future live use must demonstrate one avoided mismatched expected-package terminal without suppressing a valid new variant.
stop_rollback: If evidence links different product variants ambiguously, no authoritative prior package exists, or a conflict gate blocks a valid exact-package candidate, revert to explicit discovery classification and full post-GET Manifest/signature gate.
